about: Static DRAM (.dram0.bss + .dram0.data) per shipped variant, checked by check_static_dram.py on every release image. baseline: the last measured tree, the merge of the release line into main (78fd558e, 1 Nov 2026), so a report reads as growth since then. ceiling: the v4.5.15 ELF (b38e0a51) + 1024 B, unchanged by that re-base. Raising a ceiling needs the bench heap A/B (idle and request-start free heap, before and after) in the PR.
engine2_about: Engine-2 images (lane RB-I0), checked by check_static_dram.py like the shipped variants but kept apart from them: release.yml ships none yet (RB-FLIP adds a shipped e2 variant to `variants` when it ships). baseline: the engine-2 stub seam's measurement (20 Nov 2026, lane RB-I0 tip). ceiling: baseline + 2048 B, the shipped rows' bound; a lane that binds the engine and needs more raises it with the bench heap A/B, as for a shipped variant.
